description: This file defines the VersionGeneratorFactory class, which provides methods to generate version data based on different parameters and environment generators. It orchestrates the selection of appropriate version generators and handles the creation of version data objects.

classes.name: VersionGeneratorFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for generating version data using various version generators based on environment and input parameters.

methods.name: generateVersion
methods.description: Generates version data based on major, minor, patch offset, and a collection of version generators. Selects the first valid generator for the environment.

methods.name: generateVersion
methods.description: Overloaded method that generates version data with major, minor, and a list of generators, defaulting patch offset to zero.

methods.name: generateVersion
methods.description: Overloaded method that generates version data with major, minor, and patch offset, using a default list of environment generators.
